# Kanagawa

Kanagawa brings the Kanagawa color scheme to Obsidian. Its recorded description states that the theme supports both dark and light modes.

![Kanagawa screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sspaeti/obsidian_kanagawa/HEAD/dark.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Kanagawa"
    author: "Simon Späti"
    repo:   "sspaeti/obsidian_kanagawa"
    slug:   "kanagawa"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/kanagawa"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/sspaeti/obsidian_kanagawa"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sspaeti/obsidian_kanagawa/HEAD/dark.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "This is a Kanagawa theme for Obsidian. It supports dark and light modes."
}
```
